variants.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Generate ONE square mobile app icon for Naroo, a warm simple household budget app, using the five supplied photographs as identity references of the SAME beloved dog, not as backgrounds. Preserve the recognizable warm golden tan face, short trimmed rounded head with fluffy cheek/muzzle lobes, small asymmetrical triangular ears with folded tips (NOT tall upright ears, NOT long floppy spaniel ears), wide-set round almost-black eyes and rounded triangular black nose. Cute affectionate character interpretation specifically of this dog, not a generic puppy or shiba. App icon readability at 32px and 48px is paramount: bold compact silhouette, large separated eyes/nose, very few broad fur shapes, no individual hair strands, no fine whiskers. Clean professionally crafted flat vector-like raster, truly solid uniform color fills, crisp edges, no texture, no noise, no gradients, no lighting, no shadows, no 3D. Full bleed square background with NO baked in rounded corners or outer tile border. Entire emblem including ears fits within center 70% canvas width and height, generous even background margin for mobile rounded/circular crops. No text, numbers, watermark, badges, sparkles, scenery or extra animals. Design: isolated frontal head only, oversized adorable face with softly rounded cheek shapes, ears folding slightly outward as in photo 3. Warm honey tan #C99760 base, creamy biscuit #E8C99F muzzle, small deeper caramel ear interiors, near black #252621 eyes/nose. Calm tiny closed mouth, maximum 5 solid colors. Background solid deep sage #415744. Avoid exaggerated anime eyes; use large simple dark ovals with at most one small highlight each. Aim for a memorable minimal mascot app icon.
